Class MoleculeText

java.lang.Object
io.github.wurtzitane.avogadro.client.MoleculeText
public final class MoleculeText extends Object
Shared measured text for molecule labels; native item and HUD text remains with its owner.

  • Method Details

    • pixelAlignedScale

      public static float pixelAlignedScale(float requested)
      Fits a pixel-font label to whole framebuffer pixels, keeping at least one pixel per authored font cell.

      Call on the render thread with the label's parent transform active. Use the returned scale for centering as well as drawing. Custom item-font renderers keep their own scaling behavior.

      Parameters:
      requested - requested GUI scale
      Returns:
      a whole-pixel scale, or the requested scale when the transform has no uniform pixel grid
